title: Why we can't take you
notes: Boarding clearance (ACCESS.md 1, 3). After the first rescue's debrief.
The fiction for the gate: she locks onto combadges, and the player has none.
Names all three places an enhancer is, without a map reference: the debrief
site (marked), the station in Muldraugh, and whatever the probes find.
Must not mention a Changeling: this can ring long before the reveal.

lines.text: Shepard. The ensign you brought up has been talking. About you.
You'll have wondered why we don't just beam you up.
She finds people by their combadges. Her sensors are half blind.
To her you're one more body down there. She can't pick you out.
Not stuck. Pattern enhancers: three rods, stood round you.
They give the transporter something to hold on to.
The ensign's away kit had one. It went down where they fell.
I've marked it. The survey team kept spares in Muldraugh.
And the probes will pick up anything else that came down.
Stand them round you, out in the open, and stay with them.
It takes a while, and they hum. The dead will come to it.
And the Captain wants her own people home first.
Bring them up. Then come up yourself. Shepard out.
